name: F-16 Sound Mod (Pilot)
summary: Replacement cockpit sounds for the F-16C Viper (Beyaz Kartallar sound mod).
description: F-16C cockpit sound replacement. Copy the Sound folder into `Saved Games\DCS\Sounds\Effects\Aircrafts\Cockpits`. It does not touch the DCS install folder.
